properties.description: Rewrites docs/skills-and-tools.md's tool rows and header counts from the committed toolsnaps — kind from readOnlyHint, the line from the description's first sentence, family from the slice that serves the tool — and leaves the human prose alone. `--check` is a CI gate that fails on drift; shown to fail on one altered row before it was trusted. Exists because the page called itself "generated from the running server" and had been generated by hand once, a month before, at 21 skills and 155 tools against 26 and 180.
properties.name: render_skills_and_tools.py
